evidence_required: A recorded measurement showing 12/12 of the listed short-circuit reasons rejected and 0/4 of the genuine reasons rejected, run against the repaired enforcer.
A red-then-green record: the new must-reject cases fail before the marker lists are widened.
failing_acceptance_criteria: A verdict marking a blocking item insufficient_evidence with an 'already blocked' style reason is rejected by the enforcer.
failing_checklist_items: The reason detector in scripts/enforce_cca_verdict.py catches only the phrasings this task's own acceptance criterion literally names. Measured against 12 realistic 'already blocked' reasons a CCA judge would actually write, 8 slip through: 'Deferred pending resolution of CCA-08', 'Not reached: the verdict is blocked upstream', 'Superseded by the CCA-08 failure', 'Blocked by CCA-08, so this was left unjudged', 'Cannot be assessed while the Guardian gate fails', 'Irrelevant given the failing blocker above', 'N/A because the PR cannot merge anyway', 'Halted evaluation after the first blocking failure'. A governance gate that catches one third of realistic evasions manufactures false assurance.

The suite pins only the caught phrasings, so the 8 misses are invisible to it: the tests and the marker lists were written from the same wording, and nothing measures coverage against phrasings the criterion did not enumerate.
minimal_required_changes: Widen SKIP_MARKERS and ALREADY_BLOCKED_CAUSE_MARKERS in scripts/enforce_cca_verdict.py so all 8 measured misses are detected. Cover at least: deferred/defer, not reached, superseded, left unjudged / unjudged, cannot be assessed / cannot assess, irrelevant, n/a and not applicable when combined with an external-blocker cause, halted, pending. Keep the existing two-signal design (a skip signal AND an external already-blocked cause, or a strong standalone phrase) — it is what holds false positives at zero. Where a new cue is only meaningful with an external cause ('deferred', 'pending', 'n/a', 'irrelevant', 'halted'), add it to the skip side, not the standalone side. Extend ALREADY_BLOCKED_CAUSE_MARKERS with the cause phrasings those reasons use: 'blocked upstream', 'the failing blocker', 'blocker above', 'guardian gate fails', 'cannot merge', 'first blocking failure', 'CCA-' style item references paired with a failure word.

In tests/test_cca_completeness.py add all 12 measured short-circuit reasons as must-reject cases and all 4 genuine insufficient-evidence reasons as must-accept cases ('no test covers the new short-circuit branch', 'the e2e check was skipped due to a missing binary', 'no CI artifact records the migration run', 'the PR body does not state a risk level'). Assert zero false positives explicitly, so a later widening that starts rejecting genuine reasons fails the suite.
prohibited_changes: Do not widen the task's locks. Stay inside .github/prompts/cca-completion-check.md, scripts/enforce_cca_verdict.py, tests/test_cca_completeness.py and scripts/test_shiki_control_plane.sh.

Do not replace the reason-text mechanism with a structural rule (for example rejecting every insufficient_evidence blocking item whenever another blocking item fails). That is a different design decision, it would reject legitimate verdicts, and it is outside this frozen contract.
Do not accept any false positive on the four genuine reasons above in order to raise recall.
Do not edit the frozen task contract, its acceptance_checks, locks or risk_level.
stop_condition: If any of the 12 cannot be detected without also rejecting one of the 4 genuine reasons, stop and report that phrasing rather than trading a false positive for recall.
verification_commands: bash scripts/test_shiki_control_plane.sh && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && python3 scripts/validate_shiki.py --target .
